sources.title: Agens Volundr 32B Preview · Blockway
sources.snippet: Agens Volundr 32B Preview: a dense 32B open-weights model built for agents and long sessions. Only 18 of its 72 layers keep a KV cache. 262K context, Apache-2.0. Out now on Hugging Face.

sources.title: GitHub - BlockWayz/Agens-Volundr: Agens Volundr 32B Preview: Blockway's ...
sources.snippet: The weights are on Hugging Face. Agens Volundr 32B is an open-weights model from Blockway, built for reasoning, coding and agent work. This is a Preview release: the architecture, format and post-training pipeline are final; continued pre-training is still running and the full v1 will replace this checkpoint.

sources.title: Blockway/Agens-Volundr-32B-v1-INT4 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Agens Volundr 32B is Blockway's open-weights model for coding, reasoning and agent work — the model behind Agens. v1 is the full release the Preview (2026-10-05) announced: the same architecture, continued pre-training run to its end, and post-training built for long agent sessions.
